records.title: Code-drawn rig engine
records.description: The core art idea: no image files, every sprite drawn in code. Each pose is a set of 3D primitives (spheres, ellipsoids, cones, cylinders, boxes) rendered by one ray per pixel from the 30-degree camera, shaded from true normals with real cast shadows, a back rim, thresholded highlights and a black outline, on a ramp palette with Diablo-style light tables. All 8 directions rotate the rig rather than mirroring pixels, and animation is procedural.
records.notes: Dates for rounds before 29 are estimates: the git checkout is shallow (history starts 2026-11-03) and NOTES.md only dates round 9 (2026-10-28). The 3D remake converts the same rigs to Blender models (rigdump.js), so every animation carries over.
